{"id":2053804474,"question_id":3558,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 6 days","timestamp":1783012389,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"6 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2053804474/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find a Safe Walk Through a Grid","memory":"32.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int n , m;\n    using pi = pair<int,int>;\n    vector<vector<int>>dist;\n\n    bool ZeroOneBFS(vector<vector<int>>& grid, int health)\n    {\n        vector<int>dr = {-1 , 1 , 0 , 0};\n        vector<int>dc = {0 , 0 , 1 , -1};\n\n        dist[0][0] = grid[0][0];\n\n        deque<pi>dq;\n        dq.push_front({0 , 0});\n\n        while(!dq.empty())\n        {\n            auto[row , col] = dq.front();\n            dq.pop_front();\n\n            int cost = dist[row][col];\n\n            for(int k = 0 ; k<4 ; k++)\n            {\n                int newrow = dr[k] + row;\n                int newcol = dc[k] + col;\n                if(newrow < 0 || newrow >=n || newcol < 0 || newcol >= m) continue;\n\n                int newcost = grid[newrow][newcol];\n\n                if(cost + newcost < dist[newrow][newcol])\n                {\n                    dist[newrow][newcol] = cost + newcost;\n                    if(newcost == 0) \n                        dq.push_front({newrow , newcol});\n                    else \n                        dq.push_back({newrow , newcol});\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        int lastcellhealth = dist[n-1][m-1];\n        return (health - lastcellhealth) >= 1;\n    }\n\n    bool findSafeWalk(vector<vector<int>>& grid, int health) {\n        n = grid.size();\n        m = grid[0].size();\n\n        dist.resize(n , vector<int>(m , INT_MAX));\n\n        return ZeroOneBFS(grid , health);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-a-safe-walk-through-a-grid","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2285}
